plan.title: AD lesional vs control DE + hallmark GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: Raw Salmon gene-level counts for 6 atopic-dermatitis-lesional vs 6 control skin samples (12000 genes x 12 samples, single unpaired batch) are QC'd first because sample_01 has a library size ~4x below the median — it is inspected on PCA/sample-distance/library-size plots rather than silently dropped, per the low-depth-sample rule. DESeq2 models raw counts directly (median-of-ratios normalization inside the model, minimal pre-filter of >=10 counts in >=6 samples, Wald test with an explicit AD_lesional-vs-Control contrast, apeglm shrinkage of the reported fold change, BH-adjusted independent filtering at alpha 0.05) to answer 'which genes change'. The gene-level Wald statistic then ranks the full tested gene list for fgsea preranked GSEA against the MSigDB Hallmark human gene sets (50 sets, 2026.1 release, staged locally) to answer 'which hallmark pathways change', with leading-edge genes reported per significant set. A final report step consolidates diagnostics, gene tables, and pathway tables with full reproducibility metadata.
